evidence.quote: Coloplast is a leading global manufacturer and marketer of innovative medical devices for the management and treatment of urological conditions, including stress urinary incontinence, pelvic organ prolapse, kidney stones, erectile dysfunction and testicular replacement. || Welcome to the comprehensive resource center for healthcare professionals in the treatment of Prosthetic Urology, Endourology and Female Pelvic Medicine.
